_comment: Preset connections for the gos3 web UI. Copy this file to public/servers.json BEFORE building (served at <baseURL>servers.json; both builds bundle public/ at build time, so a file added to .output/public later is not served by the standalone Node server) or, for the standalone Node server, pass the array as NUXT_PUBLIC_SERVERS at runtime. Accepted keys per entry: id, name, endpoint|url (required), region, kind ('gos3' | 's3'), forcePathStyle|pathStyle, color (hex or a Nuxt UI color name), accessKeyId|accessKey. Never put secret keys (secretAccessKey|secretKey) here: anyone who can load the UI can read this file, so the build refuses them and the UI and gos3 ignore them; users enter their own secret key. Entries without id get 'preset-<endpoint-slug>'. Presets are read-only in the UI (only credentials can be entered there); users may hide a preset by removing it.
